# Public Repository Publication Policy

This repository contains implementation, tests, stable technical contracts, and explicitly approved public documentation only.

Do not commit:

- draft papers or proof manuscripts;
- launch or forum-submission copy;
- presentation, video, podcast, or interview scripts;
- unreleased positioning or publication strategy;
- private release-staging bundles.

Such material must remain in private staging until Thomas Helm explicitly approves publication. Approval applies to the specific reviewed revision only.
